 Social Security October 2026 Payment Schedule: Checks Due Oct. 21 and Oct. 28
 Social Security October checks arrive Oct. 21 and Oct. 28 by birth date Birth dates 11th to 20th paid Oct. 21 Those born later receive checks Oct. 28 Loading Stock video by 34168960 via Pixabay 
 Oct 19, 2026 
 Social Security October 2026 Payment Schedule: Checks Due Oct. 21 and Oct. 28
 Recipients whose birth dates fall from the 11th through the 20th of their birth month are set to get their October Social Security payment on Wednesday, Oct. 21, USA TODAY reports. The last batch of October checks follows a week later, on Wednesday, Oct. 28, for those born from the 21st through the 31st.
 Most beneficiaries are paid on Wednesdays, with the exact date tied to their birthday. The pattern: the second Wednesday for those born from the 1st through the 10th, the third Wednesday for those born from the 11th through the 20th, and the fourth Wednesday for those born from the 21st through the 31st. The Social Security Administration's 2026 payment calendar lays out this schedule.
 Beneficiaries who started receiving Social Security before May 1997 typically get paid on the third day of the month. Those who receive both Social Security and Supplemental Security Income usually get their Social Security payment on the third and their SSI payment on the first.
 What SSI payments remain in 2026?
 SSI payments usually arrive on the first of the month, and October's was issued Thursday, Oct. 1. Per the SSA payment calendar, the remaining 2026 SSI dates are Friday, Oct. 30, for November 2026; Tuesday, Dec. 1, for December 2026; and Thursday, Dec. 31, for January 2027.
 The full payment schedule, including calendars for 2026 and 2027, is available online from the Social Security Administration.
